{{Short description|Brazilian mathematician}}
{{About|a mathematician|other people of the same name|Eduardo Teixeira (disambiguation)}}
'''Eduardo V. Teixeira''' is a Brazilian mathematician working in the areas of [[Mathematical analysis|analysis]] and [[partial differential equation]]s. He holds the prestigious Kerr Professorship at the [[Oklahoma State University]];<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cas.okstate.edu/mathematics/faculty.html|title=Mathematics Faculty Oklahoma State|website=College of Arts and Sciences Okstate}}</ref> a distinguished endowed chair previously held by Prof. [[William Jaco]]. He was awarded the 2017 [[ICTP Ramanujan Prize]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/media-centre/news/2017/6/ramanujan-2017-announce.aspx|title=Ramanujan Prize Winner Announced|website=ICTP}}</ref> The prize recognized his outstanding work in the field of Analysis and Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). His contributions include work on free boundary problems, an original approach to the regularity of degenerate elliptic equations, and the founding of a major research group in nonlinear PDEs in Latin America. He obtained his Ph.D. in 2005 under the supervision of [[Luis Caffarelli]] at the [[University of Texas at Austin]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=93131|title=Eduardo Teixeira – The Mathematics Genealogy Project|website=Mathematics Genealogy}}</ref> He has been a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]] since 2014.<ref>{{cite web |title=Fellow of the Brazilian Academy of Sciences |url=https://math.rutgers.edu/news-events/news/honors-awards-distinction/1013-fellow-of-the-brazilian-academy-of-sciences |website=Rutgers.edu |language=en-gb}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=ABC elege novos membros titulares e correspondentes |url=https://www.abc.org.br/article.php3?id_article=3735 |website=Academia Brasileira de Ciências |date=21 February 2015| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150221065336/https://www.abc.org.br/article.php3?id_article=3735 | archive-date=2015-02-21 }}</ref>
